name: Create Student Certificate Template
description:
Design a 'Student of the Month' certificate template in ActivInspire.

Your task is to create a single-page flipchart with the following layout:
1. A large decorative border (rectangle) framing the page.
2. Title text 'Student of the Month' centered at the top.
3. Form fields with labels and blank lines for writing:
   - 'Awarded to:' followed by a horizontal line.
   - 'Date:' followed by a horizontal line.
   - 'Signed:' (or 'Teacher:') followed by a horizontal line.
4. Add graphical decoration using at least 2 Star or Circle shapes.

Save the completed template to '/home/ga/Documents/Flipcharts/student_certificate.flipchart'.
